criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: One dark floodlit world in register; 5 best; 3 measured; 6 an infographic; 8 a lump under a tablecloth; the dark door smallest on the cover; 9 the greyest; 2's kit car boxy.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: A filmstrip with one light and one accent meaning; the motif turns on 5 and reverses on 9; 6 and 8 slightly outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Tried to refute every slide string and the caption and found nothing; numerals trace, layout-only rows scoped, universals name their set.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A true, clear story with a turn; nothing to do, no county or deadline; Austin waits until slide 8.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: 2 pays, 5 turns, 9 closes; 3 restates 2; 6 a placeless side trip.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean on every house rule; auditor register; flat label headlines.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Floodlit plant differs from nos. 56 to 58; the lit against taped empty bay move repeats no. 56.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild the cover around frame 9's composition with a plain-words hook.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A tray with a flat blue fill.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Near black plate bleeding off four edges; milled groove; raised vinyl tape.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A lump with a tablecloth skirt.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drape to a two-seat contour with arches; low three quarter camera.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The dark door is the smallest and furthest opening.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Swing the crane so the dark door sits mid frame and large.
Rake the flood at a grazing angle so the panel faces go dark.
Crop onto the second car's glasshouse and roof rim.
